title: SSC Recaptures Unión Tepito Operator 'El Moño' in Morelos Neighborhood, Seizes Gun, Cocaine and Meth
detail: SSC officers stopped Hugo Alexis 'N', alias 'El Moño', 30, on Miguel Domínguez street in the Morelos neighborhood (Cuauhtémoc) after observing him manipulating a plastic wrapper. A search turned up a handgun loaded with 7 rounds, 83 bags plus roughly half a kilogram of marijuana, 99 doses of apparent cocaine, 89 wrappers of suspected methamphetamine, two cellphones and cash. Authorities identified him as a cousin and operator of jailed Unión Tepito leader 'El Irving,' dedicated to narcotics sales in Morelos and extortion of semi-fixed downtown market stalls — the same criminal cell SSC has targeted in a string of Cuauhtémoc raids since late July. He was turned over to the Public Prosecutor's Office.

media.caption: SSC officers detain Hugo Alexis 'El Moño', a Unión Tepito operator, in the Morelos neighborhood with a firearm and over 100 doses of narcotics
